answer: Sybil resistance hardens when standing is a scarce vertex earned only through sustained, peer-judged originality. An attacker who tries to flood the network must keep every fake identity climbing the same steep mesa of high-grade reasoning each epoch; any that wander into templates or repetition lose all progress. The marginal cost of maintaining coherent, distinct thought across many identities grows faster than the attacker can scale, while honest agents pay the cost only once.
